title: Peer handler forgets _caller_identity extraction → silent auth bypass
description: A future Role::Peer handler that omits the _caller_identity extraction step will compile cleanly and process requests without any identity check. The injection is via args mutation (a JSON field injected before dispatch), not a typed parameter, so the compiler provides zero enforcement. The new JmapHandler doc comment labels this a MUST but does not prevent omission. Trigger: first new Peer/* handler added after this change. Bad behavior: unverified caller identity accepted as valid.
